head: 946758e
note: Not every failure is fixable by routing: 070/071 are a legitimate authority denial, 126 is a source mismatch, 105 needs a clarification.

items.current_lead: I can't answer that: there is no enabled evidence source on this surface that could answer “How much did I top up with?” yet, so I would only be guessing.
items.cause: "top up" (money in) has no wallet vocabulary, so domain and facet were null

items.cause: development.status.read only accepts frame.domain office_development; the lexical classifier returned corporate_development, so only the public-surface corporate.development.read matched and the Office surface fell to the out-of-scope fallback

items.utterance: how many development projects are we running?

items.cause: a named meeting (no UI selection) reached the selected-record reader office_meetings.read ("select one first") instead of the meetings query reader that can narrow by name

items.utterance: What is the portfolio balance at the moment?
items.current_lead: I don't have a specific portfolio entry open to check — select one in Portfolio first, then ask me about it.
